newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Santander adds new posts in restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Santander adds new posts in restructuring.

text.p: Spain's leading bank Santander created several new posts in its unification of Treasury, asset management and corporate banking activities announced earlier, sources at the bank said.

Among the new appointments were Didac Artes, formerly of global markets, who takes up the new position of director of the Treasury. Emilio Botin O'Shea, also of global markets, assumes the new position of senior vice president in charge of global risk management, the sources said.
Eduardo Suarez assumes control of unifed asset management, the sources said.
